subject: KMS export attestation, dataflow diagram, and subprocessor evidence for DPA
messages:
From: Sarah Ellis <sarah.ellis@cordislabs.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Cordis Labs Procurement <procurement@cordislabs.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: KMS export attestation + dataflow diagram for DPA review

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks for the DPA draft. Before we can sign, our security team needs two pieces of evidence: a KMS export attestation (confirming no customer key material is exported outside our configured regions) and an updated dataflow diagram showing where PII is stored and which Redwood subprocessors process tokens/embeds.

Specifically, can you provide: 
- A short attestation PDF from your infra/security team that KMS keys used for our tenant are not exportable and that keys are region-bound.
- A redacted access matrix listing roles with access to PII fields and the systems controlling those permissions.
- A dataflow diagram (SVG or PNG) that calls out any cross-border transfers and which subprocessors are involved in each hop.

We'd prefer these as attachments or Drive links. Ideal timeline: 3 business days so procurement can finish the review.

Appreciate it — happy to hop on a quick call if easier.

Cheers,
Sarah Ellis
Security & Compliance Lead
Cordis Labs

[Attachment: cordis_dpa_questions.xlsx (xls)]
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Ellis <sarah.ellis@cordislabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: KMS export attestation + dataflow diagram for DPA review

Hi Sarah —

Thanks for the clear list. Looping in Marissa (Customer Success lead on this account) and Rishi (security engineering) — they'll provide the attestation and the redacted access matrix.

Quick note on scope: Redwood uses per-tenant envelope encryption where customer data keys are wrapped by our KMS keys. For Cordis Labs we can confirm keys are region-bound and we do not export raw customer key material. I'll let Rishi attach the official attestation.

Marissa — can you share the latest dataflow diagram and a redacted access matrix? If you have a one-page summary of subprocessors per data hop that'd be helpful for Sarah's reviewers.

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: redwood_dpa_summary_onepager.pdf (pdf)]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Ellis <sarah.ellis@cordislabs.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 11:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: KMS export attestation + dataflow diagram for DPA review

Sarah —

Attaching the redacted access matrix and a simplified dataflow. Notes: 
- Dataflow diagram highlights three hops: customer app -> Redwood API (hosted) -> dedicated GPU pool (if configured) -> S3 archival (optional).
- PII fields are tokenized at ingestion for embedding routes; full-text generation routes may pass larger PII payloads to the model vCPU/GPU for inference, then ephemeral KV cache is used. Persistent storage of PII is only in S3 archival buckets when retention is explicitly enabled by the customer.
- Subprocessors: compute provider (ManagedCloud Inc.), object storage provider (CloudStore+), and telemetry vendor (MetricsFlow). We include an exportable subprocessors CSV in the attachment.

Attachments: redwood_dpa_evidence_checklist.xlsx, dataflow_simple.png, access_matrix_redacted.csv

Let me know if you need more redaction or a different format. We can also provide a labeled SVG for your diagrams team.

—Marissa
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Ellis <sarah.ellis@cordislabs.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: KMS export attestation + dataflow diagram for DPA review

Sarah/Team —

Attaching the formal KMS attestation and a short implementation note: 
- Attestation: Redwood confirms that tenant-wrapping keys are non-exportable HSM-backed keys; key material cannot be exported in plain form. Export is prevented at the HSM policy layer and by our key management workflows. (See attached PDF).
- Scope: keys used for customer envelope encryption are provisioned in the same region as the tenant by default; cross-region key replication is not enabled for Cordis Labs unless explicitly requested and signed-off in contract addenda.
- Access matrix: we supply a redacted CSV that lists internal roles (SRE, Platform Engineer, Support Engineer) with Boolean access to systems that may contain PII control surfaces. Full matrix is available under NDA if you require identity-level audit trails.

Attachments: redwood_kms_scope.pdf, access_matrix_redacted.csv

If you need a signed DocuSign attestation, we can route that today — let me know.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Security Engineering Manager
Redwood Inference

Vanessa / team —

Received, thank you. The diagrams and the redacted matrix look good to us. Procurement asked for a DocuSign-ready PDF of the attestation they can attach to the signed DPA; Rishi, if you can send the DocuSign envelope or a signed PDF that would close this loop.

Proposed next steps:
- Rishi: provide DocuSign attestation (or signed PDF) by end of day tomorrow.
- Marissa: share SVG dataflow (non-raster) so our diagrams team can paste directly into the DPA exhibit.
- Vanessa: we'll aim to complete procurement review and return countersigned DPA within 48 hours after attestation.

Thanks again — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Sarah Ellis
Security & Compliance Lead
Cordis Labs
